result.title: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
result.summary: While modern video generative models achieve remarkable visual fidelity, they remain noticeably brittle when generating physically plausible dynamics and complex interactions. Targeted post-training is crucial, yet supervised fine-tuning suffers from offline state mismatch, and reinforcement learning is hindered by sparse, ill-defined physical reward functions. On-Policy (Self-)Distillation (OPSD) reconciles on-policy rollouts with dense corrective feedback, shifting the core challenge to designing effective privileged context. However, conventional modalities fall short: text prompts are inherently declarative, whereas real reference videos heavily entangle physical laws with visual appearance without parametric control. To this end, we propose PhysOPSD, introducing executable code as privileged physical context for video generation. Unlike static visual observations, executable code instantiates an editable physical world with intrinsic abstraction and controllability. Powered by PhysOPSD-Engine, we translate real-world physical scenarios into verifiable simulation programs. PhysOPSD then incorporates (i) dual-level physical privilege to bridge the information gap via an intermediate bottleneck, alongside (ii) controlled physical variations under shared rollout noise to expose causal dynamic shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PhysOPSD substantially improves physical plausibility across diverse backbones, outperforming SFT and RL baselines with only $3$K samples, while preserving general video generation quality.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PhysOPSD，把可执行代码作为特权的物理上下文用于视频生成的后训练：借助 PhysOPSD-Engine 将真实物理场景转成可验证仿真程序，再通过双层物理特权经中间瓶颈注入，并在共享 rollout 噪声下做受控物理变化以暴露因果动态差异。
AI.relevance_reason: 「特权上下文经中间瓶颈做 on-policy 蒸馏」与「受控变化下的因果归因」可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何写入内部状态、以及轨迹训练的贡献分配提供可核查线索，但其对象是视频生成而非多模态推理，联系需较多核查。
